supported_claims.claim: Applying CLR has positive impacts on NMT training for both Adam and SGD; it can be observed that the effects of applying CLR to Adam are more significant than those of SGD; we see that the trend of CLR with a larger batch size for NMT training does indeed lead to better performance.; The benefit of a larger batch size afforded by CLR means that training time can be cut down considerably.
